Cadre 3.0.2 makes pre-approval plan validation direct, read-only, and
lifecycle-aware. Track planning, review remediation, and revision proposals no
longer need temporary project copies or premature writes to canonical
`.cadre/` state.

## Changes since 3.0.1

- **Validates exact draft content.** The new read-only
  `execution_graph_validate_draft` MCP tool accepts bounded plan Markdown, an
  explicit target lifecycle status, and an optional diagnostic source label.
  It has no project-root or track-path input and performs no filesystem
  mutation.
- **Fixes track planning.** `track` validates the proposed plan as `planned`
  before approval even though canonical `plan.md` does not exist yet.
- **Fixes review remediation.** `review` validates the complete proposed
  replacement graph as `in_progress` instead of checking the stale approved
  plan under `ready_for_review` rules.
- **Fixes revision proposals.** `revise` validates changed plan content against
  its intended post-approval status before replacing approved artifacts.
- **Preserves compatibility.** The reusable content parser sits beneath the
  existing file-backed parser, and canonical `execution_graph_validate`
  remains unchanged for `implement` and other approved-plan consumers.
- **Strengthens coverage.** Tests cover derived manual-verification barriers,
  lifecycle-sensitive validation, oversized input rejection, compiled MCP
  exposure, workflow guidance, and zero filesystem mutation.

This patch does not change command names, project state schemas, templates, or
migration requirements. Existing Cadre 3.0 projects remain compatible.

## Install or upgrade

```bash
npm install -g cadre-ai@3.0.2
cadre-ai doctor
cadre-ai install --target all --scope user
```

Start a new Codex conversation and run `/reload-plugins` in Claude Code after
installation.

## Verification

- Locked workspace installation with pnpm 11.4.0.
- Harness TypeScript check, all 42 CLI/integration tests, package validation,
  and npm dry-run packing.
- Complete docs content, lint, typecheck, and static production build.
- Local-build installation with `cadre@cadre` enabled for Codex and Claude at
  the 3.0.2 candidate version.
- Installed MCP smoke coverage for file-free draft validation, derived
  barriers, and the bounded input schema.

Read the [detailed release notes](https://cadre-docs.pages.dev/release-notes/)
or the [full 3.0.1...3.0.2 comparison](https://github.com/vishal-kr-barnwal/cadre/compare/release-3.0.1...release-3.0.2).
